decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial line builds directly on the firm's long-standing natural skincare formulation know-how, and its dedicated web page signals strategic commitment, so the firm can interpret its results and refine it in-house.

A hyaluronic acid serum fits the firm's existing facial care competence and supplier base, but it is only mentioned on the website and the segment is crowded, so the risk of dropping it is somewhat higher, though still low for a small integrated producer.
A cleansing milk is a basic product closely related to the firm's core formulation knowledge and rounds out its facial care range, so it is easy to maintain and improve.
